title: Genie Ontology Modeled Knowledge SDK configuration (sdk_config.json)
description: Input contract for a Genie Ontology Modeled Knowledge SDK run (L100 Inputs & Interface Contract). Name-shape checks (3-part table names, 2-part schema names) are done in config.validate_config.

target_catalog.description: Catalog where metric views are registered; the environment discriminator.

target_schema.description: Schema where metric views are registered.

domain_context.description: Free-text description of the domain / use case being modeled.

source_schemas.description: UC schemas to evaluate, 2-part names catalog.schema.

supplemental_volume_dirs.description: UC Volume directories with supplemental context.

dashboard_inputs.description: Volume paths to Power BI / Tableau / dashboard exports.

source_catalog_for_reads.description: Source catalog override for metric view YAML source: references.

source_schema_for_reads.description: Source schema override for metric view YAML source: references.

warehouse_id.description: SQL warehouse for registration and deployment.

max_metric_views_per_agent.description: Threshold for splitting Genie Agents by subdomain.

project_root.description: Workspace path of the run project (where scaffold_project writes).

repo_path.description: Workspace Git folder path the developer can write to (L100).

skills.description: Where the SDK skills are published in Unity Catalog (build-1 R1). Sessions load <catalog>.<schema>.<id> and fall back to the SDK skills/ folder.
